Connection & setup ＋
  1. CH1 uses D23 for pump (hub P4) and D22 for valve (hub P5). Follow the module command-wire check in the firmware instructions. Wire the hub to the six-channel pin table and install the v6 MeditationVest firmware. Disconnect the actuator battery and keep JP5 open during upload.
  2. Open this HTTPS page in Bluefy. Tap Connect hub and choose MeditationVest. Each enabled channel has its own analog voltage display and controls.
  3. For first checks, keep the actuator battery disconnected. Confirm each GPIO and sensor reading before testing one actuator channel at a time.
  4. Use Run once, or set a repeat count or Until Stop. To synchronize two boards, choose them and tap Link boards. Unlink restores individual times.

Each cycle: valve selects for 0.1 s → pump → hold → release. There is no fixed wait after a single run or final cycle. Repeats use your chosen release interval; 0 s does not guarantee physical deflation.

Finite patterns finish after a Bluetooth disconnect. Until Stop finishes its current cycle and releases after disconnect. Reconnection never starts a pattern. Stop & release stops all channels when received.

All sensor inputs use 3.3 V. The graphs and percentage bars show voltage and ADC range, not calibrated pressure. Sensor readings do not stop the pumps. Current capacity for six simultaneous pumps has not been established; the six channel controls do not establish the battery or wire rating.
